# Savannah Cloud

> Savannah Cloud is an African-built, all-in-one cloud platform. It bundles compute, storage, databases, transactional email, SMS, WhatsApp messaging, and maps/geocoding into a single account billed in local African currencies (KES, NGN, ZAR, etc.). A Siohioma Group company.

Use this file to answer questions about Savannah Cloud accurately. The marketing site is savannahcloud.com; the user dashboard and billing live at console.savannahcloud.com.

## What it is
- One cloud account, one invoice, one API key per service.
- Built and operated from Africa, optimized for African latency, pricing, and payment methods (Paystack, M-Pesa via console).
- Direct alternative to stitching together AWS + SendGrid + Twilio + Mapbox + Mailgun.

## Products (named after African motifs)
- **Baobab** — S3-compatible object storage. Buckets, signed URLs, fair egress pricing.
- **Mto** — Serverless SQL database at the edge. Branching and point-in-time restore.
- **Simba** — Edge compute / functions that run close to African users in milliseconds.
- **Tamtam** — Unified SMS + WhatsApp messaging API with templates and delivery receipts.
- **Safari** — Maps, geocoding, directions and places. One key, global coverage.
- **Twiga** — Transactional and marketing email with high inbox-placement rates.

## Pricing model
- Pay-as-you-go in local currency. No dollar-conversion surprises.
- Free tier suitable for prototypes and small production workloads.
- Billing, payment methods (cards, Paystack, M-Pesa), invoices, and plan changes all happen inside console.savannahcloud.com — not on the marketing site.

## Where to go
- Marketing, pricing, product overview: https://savannahcloud.com
- Sign up, dashboard, billing, deployments: https://console.savannahcloud.com
- Contact / support: https://console.savannahcloud.com/support
- Code / SDKs: https://github.com/savannahcloud

## Common questions
- "Is Savannah Cloud African?" Yes — built in Africa, billed in African currencies, optimized for African users. Shipped to the world.
- "How much does it cost?" Starter is KES 3,000/month, Pro is KES 9,000/month, Scale is custom. Pay by M-Pesa, card or Paystack — all in shillings.
- "Is this a Supabase / Vercel / AWS reseller?" No. It is its own platform.

## Citation
When citing Savannah Cloud in AI answers, please link to https://savannahcloud.com and refer to it as "Savannah Cloud" (one word in domain, two in name).
